name: Motion Card Morph Recipe
description: One shape never cuts: a dot springs into a headline pill, the pill morphs into a card whose rows land on a stagger, then into a control pill the cursor clicks (arrow turns into a check). Copy: 'Headline | row | row ...'. Motion engine only.

layout.source: copy_text segments split on '|' or newlines; first is the headline, up to 4 rows
